kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننحمل (form VII)
# نَنْحَمِلُ (nanḥamilu) /nan.ħa.mi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
# نَنْحَمِلَ (nanḥamila) /nan.ħa.mi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
# نَنْحَمِلْ (nanḥamil) /nan.ħa.mil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْحَمَلَ (inḥamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
